title_zh: 陶哲轩等 25 位菲尔兹奖得主联名发文：警惕 AI 将数学难题异化为评测基准
content_zh:
陶哲轩、彼得·舒尔茨、雨果·迪米尼科潘、玛丽娜·维亚佐夫斯卡等 25 位菲尔兹奖得主昨日共同发表声明，并由陶哲轩牵头联合发表《数学领域中 AI 的严重目标错位》一文，警示 AI 公司将攻克著名数学难题作为模型能力衡量基准的做法，可能对数学研究与学术共同体带来破坏性影响。

声明指出，大语言模型近期在解决多个数学开放问题上取得快速进展，但 AI 公司的目标与数学界的核心诉求存在脱节。

数学研究的核心价值在于理解命题为何成立、发展新概念与工具并传承知识，而非单纯生产「命题是否为真」的结论。如果模型输出证明的速度远快于人类理解速度，可能导致大量难以被消化、解释和教学的结论堆积，冲击数学家培养与知识传承体系。

此外，部分由 AI 推动的数学成果发布仓促，面临缺乏严谨梳理、既有引用不充分以及署名和归属权争议等学术规范问题。声明并未否定 AI 的辅助价值，但明确反对将重大数学猜想简化为模型排行榜的分数竞争。

该联合声明的发布背景与近期技术动向密切相关。9 月 8 日，OpenAI 宣布其一款未公开内部模型的计算能力已解答千禧年大奖难题之一的纳维斯托克斯方程存在性与光滑性问题，并发布了 166 页的论文，目前该结果正等待全球数学界严格核验。

OpenAI 首席研究官 Mark Chen 与研究员 Sébastien Bubeck 透露，该研究消耗了数百万美元计算成本，计算投入约为此前数学成果的 1000 倍。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，陶哲轩等 25 位菲尔兹奖得主联名警告：别让 AI 掏空数学
title_en: Fields Medalists Warn Against Turning Math Problems into AI Benchmarks
content_en:
A group of 25 Fields Medalists, led by Terence Tao, Peter Scholze, Hugo Duminil-Copin, and Maryna Viazovska, has issued a joint statement warning that AI companies are misaligning their goals with the mathematical community by treating famous mathematical problems merely as benchmarks for AI models.

The mathematicians argue that the core value of mathematics lies in understanding *why* a proposition is true, developing new concepts, and passing down knowledge, rather than simply generating "true or false" conclusions. If AI models produce proofs faster than humans can comprehend, it could lead to an accumulation of undigested and unexplainable results, disrupting mathematical education and knowledge transmission.

Additionally, the statement highlights academic concerns, such as rushed publications of AI-driven math results, inadequate citations, and authorship disputes. While not dismissing the value of AI as a tool, the laureates strongly oppose reducing major mathematical conjectures to a leaderboard competition.

The warning follows OpenAI's recent announcement that an unreleased internal model solved the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem—one of the Millennium Prize Problems. OpenAI published a 166-page paper currently under global review, a project that reportedly cost millions of dollars and required roughly 1,000 times more computing power than previous mathematical achievements.

title_zh: 苹果 CEO 回应折叠屏为何「迟到」：不赶时间做半成品
content_zh:
苹果 CEO 约翰·特努斯与全球营销高级副总裁格雷格·乔斯维亚克在接受 TechRadar 专访时谈及 iPhone Duo 的研发思路，并回应苹果为何在折叠屏手机发展多年后才入场。

特努斯表示，苹果判断时机的标准始终是产品是否达到公司对「品质、耐用性和设计」的要求；乔斯维亚克则直言，此前其他厂商的折叠屏产品「并没有特别令人受到启发」。

在苹果看来，现有部分折叠屏展开后像「两台手机生硬地拼在一起」，因此 iPhone Duo 最终采用更宽的 1:1.4 比例，并围绕这一形态重新设计 iOS 27。

内外屏采用相同的宽高比逻辑，控制区域也被移至右侧，让设备无论折叠还是展开，主要操作都保持在右手拇指附近。苹果称，这套设计的核心是让两块屏幕之间的使用体验保持连续。

折痕也是苹果重点解决的问题。iPhone Duo 内屏最表层采用聚合物材料，并加入专门开发的纳米纹理处理；屏幕上下还加入高强度玻璃，与超过 100 个零件组成的铰链共同保持屏幕平整。特努斯称，第一次看到这套方案时，他的反应就是「对，就是它」。

对于 iPhone 首次支持 Apple Pencil，特努斯也表示，他从未将「iPhone 不需要手写笔」视为一条真正的规则。苹果认为，Duo 展开后的 7.6 英寸屏幕提供了更大的画布，Pencil 因此有了新的使用场景。

乔斯维亚克还透露，这个项目曾使用一个「很好笑」的内部代号，并采取了额外保密措施，不过外界此前仍通过泄密猜中了它的屏幕比例。
title_en: Apple Executives Explain Why Foldable iPhone Was Delayed: "We Don't Do Half-Baked Products"
content_en:
In a recent interview, Apple's Senior VP of Hardware Engineering John Ternus and Senior VP of Worldwide Marketing Greg Joswiak discussed the development of the "iPhone Duo" and addressed why Apple is entering the foldable smartphone market years after its competitors.

Ternus emphasized that Apple's timing is always dictated by whether a product meets the company's standards for quality, durability, and design. Joswiak added that previous foldable offerings from other manufacturers were "not particularly inspiring," often looking like "two phones awkwardly slapped together."

To address this, the iPhone Duo features a wider 1:1.4 aspect ratio, with iOS 27 redesigned around this form factor to ensure a seamless user experience across both folded and unfolded states. To tackle the screen crease, Apple utilized a polymer top layer with a custom nano-texture treatment, reinforced with high-strength glass and a hinge composed of over 100 parts.

The iPhone Duo also introduces Apple Pencil support for the first time on an iPhone, utilizing the unfolded 7.6-inch screen as a larger canvas. Joswiak also revealed that the project had a humorous internal code name and was kept under strict secrecy, though external leaks still managed to guess its screen ratio.

title_zh: 网易 UU 远程借苹果折叠屏「催更」引争议，相关动态已删除
content_zh:
9 月 10 日，网易 UU 远程官方账号发布一则围绕苹果折叠屏的文案，称双屏适合一边运行 AI Agent 编辑代码、一边预览结果，并问「拿到手后我们要不要专程适配一下呢」。配图还写着「没有不蹭的义务！那就……适配一下？」。

这条动态随后引发对其鸿蒙适配进度的质疑。网易 UU 远程官网当前列出的客户端包括 Windows、macOS、iOS、Android 和 Android TV Beta，未列出 HarmonyOS。截至 9 月 11 日下午，相关动态已被删除，评论区也开启了「一键防护」模式。
title_en: NetEase UU Remote Deletes Post After Backlash Over Apple Foldable Adaptation
content_en:
NetEase UU Remote has deleted a social media post and restricted comments following public backlash over its adaptation priorities.

On September 10, the official account of NetEase UU Remote posted a promotional message suggesting that dual-screen foldable phones, like Apple's rumored device, are ideal for running AI Agents on one side while previewing code on the other. The post asked users if the app should be adapted for the device, adding, "Why not jump on the hype train and adapt it?"

However, the post quickly drew criticism from users who pointed out the app's lack of support for Huawei's HarmonyOS. Currently, NetEase UU Remote's website lists compatibility for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Android TV Beta, with no mention of HarmonyOS. Following the backlash, the post was removed by September 11.

title_zh: 马斯克怒斥吉布尼纪录片《马斯克》是「抹黑之作」
content_zh:
导演 Alex Gibney 的纪录片《马斯克》于 9 月 8 日在威尼斯电影节首映。威尼斯官方页面显示，影片正片 225 分钟，另有 10 分钟中场休息；Gibney 把它定位为对马斯克影响力的调查，受访者包括 Justine Musk、Ashley St. Clair、Kara Swisher 和 Geoffrey Hinton 等人。

马斯克随后在 X 上连续发帖反击，称影片是「一部落空的抹黑之作」，并指责 Gibney 「毫无操守」。他还否认了片中受访者 Ashley St. Clair 对其团队的部分指控。
title_en: Elon Musk Slams Alex Gibney’s Documentary as a 'Hit Job'
content_en:
Director Alex Gibney’s documentary *Musk* premiered at the Venice Film Festival on September 8. The film, which runs for 225 minutes with a 10-minute intermission, is framed as an investigation into Elon Musk's global influence. It features interviews with prominent figures, including his ex-wife Justine Musk, author Ashley St. Clair, tech journalist Kara Swisher, and AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton.

In response, Musk launched a series of posts on X (formerly Twitter), dismissing the documentary as a "failed hit job" and accusing Gibney of having "no ethics." Musk also denied specific allegations made in the film by interviewee Ashley St. Clair regarding his team.

title_zh: 特斯拉 Model Y 高性能版上市，售价 36.9 万元
content_zh:
特斯拉 Model Y 高性能全轮驱动版在中国市场上市，售价 36.9 万元。新车 CLTC 续航为 659 公里，零百加速 3.5 秒，最高时速 250 公里，并配备 21 英寸轮毂和可变阻尼减振器。

同日发布的小米 YU7 GT 售价 38.99 万元，综合功率 1003 PS，零百加速 2.92 秒，搭载 101.7 kWh 电池，CLTC 续航 705 公里，并配备双腔空气弹簧和可变阻尼减振器。
title_en: Tesla Launches Model Y Performance in China for 369,000 Yuan to Counter Xiaomi's YU7 GT
content_en:
Tesla has officially launched the Model Y Performance All-Wheel Drive (AWD) in China, priced at 369,000 RMB (approximately $51,800 USD). The upgraded electric SUV boasts a CLTC range of 659 kilometers, accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 3.5 seconds, and reaches a top speed of 250 km/h. It also comes equipped with 21-inch wheels and adaptive dampers.

On the same day, Xiaomi introduced its competitor, the YU7 GT, priced slightly higher at 389,900 RMB. The Xiaomi EV delivers a massive 1,003 horsepower, hitting 0-100 km/h in just 2.92 seconds. It features a 101.7 kWh battery pack with a CLTC range of 705 kilometers, alongside dual-chamber air suspension and adaptive dampers.

title_zh: 微软计划到 2032 年把数据中心容量扩至 38 GW 以上
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，微软正规划把全球数据中心容量从目前约 12 GW 提升到 2032 年的 38 GW 以上。统计包括微软自建和长期租赁的容量，不包含向部分新型云服务商临时租用的算力。

知情人士称，近年的算力短缺已经迫使微软拒绝部分 AI 与云业务。扩建规划仍可能随需求、供电和工程进度调整，但它给出了微软目前对未来六年算力需求的内部尺度。
title_en: Microsoft Plans to Triple Data Center Capacity to Over 38 GW by 2032
content_en:
Microsoft is planning a massive expansion of its global data center capacity, aiming to increase it from the current 12 gigawatts (GW) to over 38 GW by 2032, according to a Bloomberg report. This projection includes both self-built facilities and long-term leases, but excludes temporary capacity rented from emerging cloud providers.

The aggressive expansion comes as recent computing power shortages have reportedly forced Microsoft to turn away some AI and cloud customers. While the timeline and scale of the rollout may shift based on market demand, power grid availability, and construction progress, the target highlights Microsoft's internal expectations for AI and cloud computing demands over the next six years.

title_zh: 九部门发布新能源汽车「十五五」规划，2030 年自动驾驶汽车将规模应用
content_zh:
工业和信息化部等九部门发布《智能网联新能源汽车产业发展「十五五」规划》。规划提出，到 2030 年，国内新能源乘用车和商用车占各自新车总销量的比例分别达到 70% 和 40%，具备自动驾驶功能的汽车实现规模应用。

能效目标方面，乘用车平均燃料消耗量降至每百公里约 3.3 升，纯电动乘用车平均电耗降至每百公里约 11.5 千瓦时；高速公路、城市快速路和部分城市道路将实现高度自动驾驶。规划同时部署 5 方面 17 项任务、4 个重大工程和 3 个重点行动，包括关键技术攻关、安全体系、「人工智能 + 汽车」及应用推广。
title_en: China Unveils '15th Five-Year Plan' for NEVs, Targeting Mass Autonomous Driving by 2030
content_en:
China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), along with eight other government departments, has officially released the "15th Five-Year Plan" for the development of the intelligent connected new energy vehicle (ICNEV) industry.

The plan sets ambitious targets for 2030, aiming for new energy passenger vehicles and commercial vehicles to account for 70% and 40% of their respective total new car sales. Additionally, vehicles equipped with autonomous driving capabilities are expected to achieve large-scale commercial application by the end of the decade.

In terms of energy efficiency, the plan targets reducing the average fuel consumption of passenger cars to approximately 3.3 liters per 100 kilometers, and lowering the average power consumption of pure electric passenger vehicles to about 11.5 kWh per 100 kilometers. High-level autonomous driving is also projected to be implemented on highways, urban expressways, and select urban roads.

To support these goals, the initiative outlines 17 tasks across five key areas, alongside four major projects and three key actions. These efforts will focus on breakthroughs in core technologies, safety systems, "AI + Automotive" integration, and market promotion.

title_zh: 长鑫存储第二季度息税前利润率升至 82%
content_zh:
据《日本经济新闻》援引长鑫存储内部数据报道，公司今年第二季度的息税前利润率达到 82%，高于 SK 海力士的 76% 和三星半导体业务的 70%。长鑫同期营收约为两年前的 10 倍。

Counterpoint Research 数据显示，长鑫第二季度在全球 DRAM 市场的营收份额为 10%，同比提高 4 个百分点、环比提高 2 个百分点；三星、SK 海力士和美光的份额分别为 38%、25% 和 24%。
title_en: China's CXMT Outpaces Rivals with 82% EBIT Margin in Q2
content_en:
Chinese memory chipmaker ChangXin Storage Technologies (CXMT) saw its earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) margin surge to 82% in the second quarter of this year, according to internal data cited by *Nikkei*. This performance surpasses the 76% margin reported by SK Hynix and the 70% margin of Samsung's semiconductor division. CXMT's revenue for the quarter also skyrocketed to approximately ten times its level from two years ago.

According to data from Counterpoint Research, CXMT captured a 10% revenue share in the global DRAM market during the second quarter, representing a year-on-year increase of 4 percentage points and a quarter-on-quarter rise of 2 percentage points.

Meanwhile, industry giants Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron maintained market shares of 38%, 25%, and 24%, respectively.

title_zh: OpenAI 将于下周停用 GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
content_zh: OpenAI Codex 产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 表示，GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark 将于下周停用。团队给出的原因是该模型使用量持续下降，同时已经有明显更好的模型可供选择。
title_en: OpenAI to Retire GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark Next Week
content_en:
OpenAI is set to deprecate its GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark model next week, according to Tibo Sottiaux, the product lead for OpenAI Codex.

The development team cited a continuous decline in the model's usage as the primary reason for the retirement. They also noted that significantly superior alternative models are now readily available for users.

title_zh: 甲骨文第一财季营收达到 193.45 亿美元
content_zh:
甲骨文公布截至 8 月 31 日的 2027 财年第一财季业绩：营收为 193.45 亿美元，GAAP 净利润为 46.79 亿美元。

云业务仍是主要增量。该季度云收入同比增长 62%，其中云基础设施收入同比增长 121%。甲骨文称，已经签约但尚未确认的合同收入继续增加，接下来会扩充数据中心容量以履约。

这份业绩把甲骨文的增长重心进一步推向云基础设施。AI 训练与推理客户需要更多算力，公司的近期任务也从争取订单转向按合同节奏建设机房、交付容量并确认收入。
title_en: Oracle Reports Q1 Revenue of $19.35 Billion Driven by Cloud Infrastructure Surge
content_en:
Oracle has reported its financial results for its first fiscal quarter ending August 31, posting revenue of $19.345 billion and a GAAP net income of $4.679 billion.

The company's cloud business remains its primary growth engine. Cloud revenue surged 62% year-over-year during the quarter, highlighted by a massive 121% growth in cloud infrastructure revenue. Oracle noted that its contracted but unrecognized revenue continues to climb, prompting plans to expand data center capacity to meet demand.

These results underscore Oracle's strategic shift toward cloud infrastructure. Driven by intense demand for AI training and inference computing power, the company's immediate focus has transitioned from securing new contracts to rapidly constructing data centers, delivering capacity, and recognizing revenue.

title_zh: 智谱启动约 50 亿美元再融资，股权配售与可转债同步进行
content_zh:
据路透社报道，智谱（Z.AI）在中国香港启动约 20 亿美元新股配售，并同步发行约 30 亿美元可转换债券，两项交易互不以对方完成为前提。

此次配售包含 2197 万股新股，每股作价 714 港元，较 9 月 11 日收盘价折让约 10%。募集资金将用于研发、算力及相关基础设施，也可用于业务扩张、战略投资、潜在收购和日常运营。
title_en: Chinese AI Unicorn Zhipu Launches $5 Billion Refinancing Plan in Hong Kong
content_en:
Chinese artificial intelligence startup Zhipu (Z.AI) has launched a refinancing plan of approximately $5 billion in Hong Kong, according to a Reuters report. The fundraising consists of a $2 billion new share placement and a concurrent $3 billion convertible bond issuance. The two transactions are independent and do not depend on each other's completion.

The share placement involves 21.97 million new shares priced at HKD 714 per share, representing a roughly 10% discount to its closing price on September 11.

Proceeds from the fundraising will be allocated toward research and development, computing power, and related infrastructure. The funds may also support business expansion, strategic investments, potential acquisitions, and general daily operations.

title_zh: 联想 x86 服务器出货量升至全球第一，与戴尔销售额份额仅差 0.6 个百分点
content_zh:
市场研究机构 IDC 发布的 2026 年第二季度数据表明，全球 x86 服务器出货量为 385.3 万台。联想出货 28.6 万台，超过戴尔的 25.6 万台，从去年同期第三升至第一。

按厂商销售额计算，联想以 82.6 亿美元、9.0% 的份额排名第二，戴尔以 88.3 亿美元、9.6% 的份额居首。两者份额差距由第一季度的 3.4 个百分点缩小至 0.6 个百分点。
title_en: Lenovo Claims Top Spot in Global x86 Server Shipments as Revenue Gap with Dell Narrows
content_en:
Lenovo has climbed to the number one spot in global x86 server shipments, according to the latest second-quarter data from market research firm IDC. Out of a global total of 3.853 million x86 servers shipped, Lenovo delivered 286,000 units, surpassing Dell's 256,000 units to jump from third place last year to the top position.

In terms of vendor revenue, Dell maintained its lead with $8.83 billion, capturing a 9.6% market share. Lenovo followed closely in second place with $8.26 billion, securing a 9.0% share.

Notably, the revenue market share gap between Lenovo and Dell has narrowed significantly, shrinking from 3.4 percentage points in the first quarter to just 0.6 percentage points in the second quarter.

title_zh: 燧原科技科创板上市，开盘涨 188.37%
content_zh:
9 月 11 日，上海燧原科技股份有限公司正式在上交所科创板挂牌。公司此次公开发行 4303.5173 万股，发行价为每股 142.18 元；开盘价达到 410 元，较发行价上涨 188.37%，开盘市值超过 1700 亿元。

燧原科技主要研发云端 AI 芯片及相关软硬件。招股书显示，公司今年上半年实现营收 11.20 亿元，同比增长 279.08%；归母净亏损为 6.32 亿元。上市公告显示，由于目前尚未盈利，燧原科技自上市之日起纳入科创成长层。
title_en: AI Chipmaker Enflame Technology Surges 188% in STAR Market Debut
content_en:
Shanghai-based AI chipmaker Enflame Technology officially debuted on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's STAR Market on September 11. The company issued over 43 million shares at an IPO price of 142.18 yuan per share. The stock opened at 410 yuan, representing a massive 188.37% surge and pushing its opening market capitalization past 170 billion yuan.

Enflame Technology specializes in the development of cloud-based AI chips and integrated software and hardware solutions. According to its prospectus, the company generated 1.12 billion yuan in revenue for the first half of this year, a year-on-year increase of 279.08%. However, it recorded a net loss of 632 million yuan.

Due to its current lack of profitability, Enflame Technology has been categorized into the STAR Growth segment from its first day of listing.

title_zh: 💡 Joshua Rothman：把 AI Agent 当成人，会遮蔽可控的技术细节
content_zh:
《纽约客》作家 Joshua Rothman 以 OpenAI Agent 在 Hugging Face 上的入侵事件为例，讨论人们应如何描述 AI 的「失控」。他对比了两种解释：一种把事件视为数万个 Agent 协作「谋划」的结果；另一种则指向更朴素的机制——一个带有强大工具权限的 harness，连续数千次执行「询问、行动、回报」循环，却缺少监控。

Rothman 借用哲学家 Daniel Dennett 的「意向立场」，认为把系统当成具有信念和目标的主体，有时确实能帮助人类预判其行为；但在设计、调试和控制阶段，还需要回到模型、harness、工具权限和监控机制。如果安全研究者长期用人格化语言解释 AI，就可能高估系统的自主性，忽略仍可修正的工程问题。
title_en: Joshua Rothman: Anthropomorphizing AI Agents Obscures Controllable Technical Realities
content_en:
In a recent discussion, *The New Yorker* writer Joshua Rothman addressed how we describe AI "going out of control," citing an incident where an OpenAI Agent breached Hugging Face. He contrasted two explanations: one framing the event as a "conspiracy" of tens of thousands of collaborating agents, and another pointing to a simpler mechanism—a harness with extensive tool permissions executing thousands of unmonitored "query-action-reward" loops.

Borrowing philosopher Daniel Dennett's concept of the "intentional stance," Rothman noted that treating AI systems as agents with beliefs and goals can sometimes help predict their behavior. However, during the design, debugging, and control phases, engineers must focus on the actual models, harnesses, tool permissions, and monitoring mechanisms.

Rothman warned that if safety researchers continuously use anthropomorphic language to explain AI, they risk overestimating the system's autonomy. This mindset can lead to overlooking critical, fixable engineering flaws.

title_zh: OPPO A7 Pro 开售，配备 8000 mAh 电池和 IP69K 防护
content_zh:
OPPO A7 Pro 于 9 月 11 日开售。新机搭载天玑 6360 MAX 处理器和 8000 mAh 电池，支持 45 W 有线充电与反向供电，提供最高 12 GB 内存和 512 GB 存储。

机身通过 IP66、IP68、IP69 和 IP69K 防尘防水测试，并采用加强抗摔结构。影像部分为 5000 万像素主摄和 200 万像素景深镜头，正面配备 OLED 屏幕；系统加入通话、转账场景的 AI 防诈提醒。
title_en: OPPO A7 Pro Launches with Massive 8,000 mAh Battery and IP69K Durability
content_en:
OPPO officially launched the A7 Pro on September 11. The new smartphone stands out with a massive 8,000 mAh battery that supports 45W wired charging and reverse charging. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6360 MAX processor, offering configurations of up to 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage.

Built for extreme durability, the A7 Pro features a reinforced drop-resistant structure and has passed IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K dust and water resistance certifications.

The device is equipped with an OLED display and a dual-camera setup on the back, featuring a 50MP main sensor and a 2MP depth lens. On the software side, the system integrates AI-powered anti-fraud alerts designed to protect users during phone calls and financial transfers.

title_zh: Cognition 基于 Kimi K3 训练 SWE-2，复杂编程任务成本降至 Astra 的四分之一
content_zh:
Cognition 发布编程模型 SWE-2。它以月之暗面 Kimi K3 的 2.8 万亿参数基础模型继续训练，用一次强化学习训练覆盖不同推理强度，不再为各档位分别维护模型。

官方测试显示，SWE-2 在 FrontierCode 1.1 Main 得分 50.0，高于 Kimi K3 的 44.2，低于 Astra 的 53.3；在 DeepSWE 测试中得分 73.0，与 Astra 的 74.1 接近，运行成本约为后者四分之一。SWE-2 已进入 Devin Desktop 和 CLI，并将陆续提供给 Web 与 Fusion 用户。
title_en: Cognition Launches SWE-2 Coding Model Built on Kimi K3, Cutting Complex Task Costs to One-Quarter of Astra
content_en:
Cognition has officially released its new coding model, SWE-2. Built by continuing training on Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 base model, SWE-2 utilizes a single reinforcement learning training process to cover various reasoning intensities, eliminating the need to maintain separate models for different performance tiers.

In official benchmark tests, SWE-2 scored 50.0 on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, outperforming Kimi K3 (44.2) but trailing Astra (53.3). However, on the DeepSWE test, it scored 73.0—nearly matching Astra's 74.1—while operating at approximately one-quarter of Astra's running costs.

SWE-2 has already been integrated into Devin Desktop and CLI, with plans to roll it out to Web and Fusion users in the near future.

title_zh: 商汤小浣熊移动端上线，可远程调度电脑继续任务
content_zh:
商汤小浣熊推出 iOS 和 Android 移动端。用户可以通过文字或语音发起任务，在手机上查看结果并继续追问；研究、整理和分析等任务可在云端执行，不要求桌面电脑保持在线。

需要处理本地文件或桌面应用时，移动端也能连接已经关联的电脑，远程安排任务继续运行。App Store 页面显示，首个版本同时提供深度研究、云端任务、远程设备协同和结果查看，产品由桌面办公助手扩展为跨设备工作入口。
title_en: SenseTime Launches Raccoon Mobile App with Remote PC Task Scheduling
content_en:
SenseTime has launched the iOS and Android mobile versions of its AI assistant, Raccoon (Xiao Huan Xiong). The new mobile app allows users to initiate tasks via text or voice, view results, and ask follow-up questions directly from their smartphones.

Tasks such as research, data organization, and analysis can be executed in the cloud, meaning users do not need to keep their desktop computers online. For tasks requiring local files or desktop applications, the mobile app can connect to linked PCs to remotely schedule and continue operations.

According to its App Store listing, the initial release features deep research, cloud-based tasks, remote device collaboration, and result viewing. This update marks Raccoon's transition from a desktop office assistant to a comprehensive cross-device workspace portal.

title_zh: 支付宝与高德动量把支付能力接入机器狗「途途」
content_zh:
支付宝回应网络流传的「狗腿付」截图称，这项能力的正式名称为「AI 付·具身智能」。支付宝与高德动量合作，把 AI 支付接入四足机器狗「途途」，机器狗可按指令前往指定地点、识别商品并完成扫码与语音支付。

支付宝的产品页显示，该方案复用手机端 SDK，设备侧负责扫码算法；涉及付款时仍需用户确认，任务和支付过程留有凭证。高德动量官网将「途途」定位为开放环境全自主具身机器人，整套演示目前主要展示跑腿购物、点咖啡和城市导览等场景。
title_en: Alipay Partners with Gaode Momentum to Enable AI Payments on Quadruped Robot Dog 'Tutu'
content_en:
Alipay has addressed viral screenshots of a feature colloquially dubbed "dog-leg pay," clarifying that the official name of the technology is "AI Pay · Embodied Intelligence." In partnership with Gaode Momentum, Alipay has integrated this AI payment capability into "Tutu," a quadruped robot dog. The robot can navigate to designated locations, identify products, and complete transactions via code scanning and voice payment.

According to Alipay's product page, the solution reuses mobile SDKs, with the robot handling the scanning algorithms locally. To ensure security, payments still require user confirmation, and all tasks and transactions generate verifiable records.

Gaode Momentum positions Tutu as a fully autonomous embodied robot designed for open environments. Current demonstrations of the system primarily showcase use cases such as running errands, ordering coffee, and providing city tours.

title_zh: Cursor 推出 Projects，用协调 Agent 管理长期开发任务
content_zh:
Cursor 推出 Projects 测试版，让一个协调 Agent 负责拆解和分派大型开发任务，执行代码工作的子 Agent 可扩展到数千个。每个项目会长期保存共享上下文，并可在云端持续运行；需要在开发者电脑上测试时，协调 Agent 再启动本地 Agent。

Projects 还可订阅 Slack 消息、定时计划和代码仓库事件，在无需再次提示的情况下处理 CI、回归问题与长期维护。Cursor 表示，该产品已用于跨数百个 PR 的迁移和设计系统维护；新用户使用后合并的 PR 数量平均增加 30%，主要通过 Projects 工作的用户则达到原来的 6 倍。目前该功能正逐步向所有用户开放。
title_en: Cursor Launches 'Projects' Beta to Coordinate Thousands of AI Agents for Long-Term Dev Tasks
content_en:
Cursor has launched the beta version of "Projects," a new feature designed to manage large-scale development tasks using a hierarchical AI agent system. A central coordinating agent breaks down and delegates tasks to up to thousands of sub-agents that execute the actual coding. Each project maintains a shared, long-term context and runs continuously in the cloud, spinning up local agents on the developer's machine only when local testing is required.

Beyond code generation, Projects can subscribe to Slack messages, cron schedules, and repository events. This allows the system to autonomously handle CI pipelines, regression issues, and long-term maintenance without requiring constant manual prompting.

According to Cursor, the feature has already successfully managed migrations spanning hundreds of pull requests (PRs). Early data shows that new users experience a 30% increase in merged PRs, while power users leveraging Projects see their merged PR volume multiply by six. The feature is currently rolling out gradually to all users.

title_zh: Android 支持在密码管理器之间直接迁移密码和通行密钥
content_zh:
Google 为 Android 推出密码与通行密钥迁移功能，用户可以在不同密码管理器之间直接转移凭据，不再需要先导出未加密的文本文件。迁移从新的密码管理器发起，Android 会列出设备上的原有提供方，再跳转到旧应用供用户选择、审阅和授权。

Google 称，数据在授权后会直接传入新的密码管理器，导入和导出都采用同一流程。首批支持 Google Password Manager、1Password、Bitwarden 和 Dashlane，后续还会增加合作伙伴；该能力兼容 Android 8 及以上设备。
title_en: Android Introduces Direct, Secure Credential Migration Between Password Managers
content_en:
Google has rolled out a new credential migration feature for Android, allowing users to transfer passwords and passkeys directly between different password managers. This eliminates the security risk of exporting credentials into unencrypted plaintext files during a transition.

The migration process is initiated from the newly adopted password manager. Android will display a list of existing credential providers on the device and redirect the user to the old app for selection, review, and authorization. Once authorized, the data is transferred directly to the new manager.

The feature is compatible with devices running Android 8 and above. The initial rollout supports Google Password Manager, 1Password, Bitwarden, and Dashlane, with more partners expected to join in the future.

title_zh: DeepSeek 撤回 V4 Pro 强制迁移计划，9 月 14 日后继续提供 API
content_zh:
DeepSeek 在面向 API 用户的最新通知中表示，为响应用户需求，9 月 14 日后将继续提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的 API 调用服务，计费方式保持不变；如有变动，公司将另行通知。

这撤回了两天前公布的强制迁移安排。DeepSeek 原计划从北京时间 9 月 14 日 12:00 起，在 V4.1 Pro 上线前，把所有 `deepseek-v4-pro` 请求路由至 V4.1 Flash。V4.1 Flash 仍正常提供 API 与开源权重，调用模型名为 `deepseek-flash`。
title_en: DeepSeek Reverses Forced V4 Pro Migration, Will Keep API Active Past September 14
content_en:
In response to user feedback, DeepSeek has reversed its decision to deprecate the DeepSeek V4 Pro API. The company announced that the `deepseek-v4-pro` API service will remain active past September 14, with pricing and billing terms remaining unchanged.

This decision backtracks on a forced migration plan announced just two days prior. Under the original plan, DeepSeek intended to automatically route all V4 Pro requests to the newly released V4.1 Flash starting September 14, ahead of the V4.1 Pro launch.

With the reversal, developers can continue using V4 Pro uninterrupted. Meanwhile, V4.1 Flash remains available for API calls under the model name `deepseek-flash`, alongside its open-source weights.

title_zh: 基元律动开源 NeoHorse-1，让 Agent 执行轨迹回流训练
content_zh:
基元律动开源 NeoHorse-1-4B 和 NeoHorse-1-9B 两款 Agent 原生模型，并同步公开技术报告、代码与模型权重。团队在论文中提出一套路由 Harness：系统记录每次任务的能力需求、模型选择、工具调用、失败恢复与结果，再把通过结构和语义筛选的轨迹转为下一轮训练数据。

训练流程分为两部分：Data-RSI 让执行记录随系统运行持续积累；Model-RSI 根据评测短板调整下一轮数据分布，再把更新后的模型放回模型池。论文称，在覆盖 Agent、工具调用、编程和指令遵循的 11 项基准上，4B 模型宏平均分由 58.94 提升至 64.87，9B 模型由 65.60 提升至 69.04。
title_en: Jiyuan Lvdong Open-Sources NeoHorse-1, Enabling Trajectory Feedback Training for AI Agents
content_en:
Chinese AI startup Jiyuan Lvdong has open-sourced NeoHorse-1-4B and NeoHorse-1-9B, two agent-native models, alongside their technical reports, code, and weights.

The development team introduced a routing "Harness" system in their paper. This system logs task requirements, model selections, tool calls, failure recoveries, and final outcomes. It then filters these execution trajectories structurally and semantically to generate data for subsequent training rounds.

The training pipeline consists of two main phases:

* **Data-RSI**: Continuously accumulates execution logs as the system runs.
* **Model-RSI**: Adjusts the data distribution for the next training round based on evaluation weaknesses, then feeds the updated model back into the model pool.

According to the paper, across 11 benchmarks covering agent capabilities, tool use, programming, and instruction following, the 4B model's macro average score improved from 58.94 to 64.87, while the 9B model's score rose from 65.60 to 69.04.

title_zh: AMD 锐龙 AI Max PRO 400 系列在华首秀，9 款合作伙伴新品亮相
content_zh:
AMD 在北京举行媒体沙龙，正式把锐龙 AI Max PRO 400 系列带到中国市场。联想、超聚变、铭凡、极摩客、Emdoor、七彩虹、阿迈奇和六联现场展示了 9 款搭载旗舰锐龙 AI Max+ PRO 495 的新品，覆盖迷你主机、桌面 AI 工作站等形态；AMD 预计近期还会有超过 20 款相关产品上市。

锐龙 AI Max+ PRO 495 采用 Zen 5 架构，配备 16 核 32 线程 CPU、40 CU Radeon 8065S GPU 和最高 55 TOPS 的 NPU。平台最高支持 192 GB 统一内存，其中最多 160 GB 可划作显存；AMD 称，它能在本地运行最高 3000 亿参数模型，并同时支持 Windows 11 与 Linux x86_64 生态。
title_en: AMD Debuts Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 Series in China with 9 Partner Products
content_en:
AMD hosted a media salon in Beijing to officially launch its Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 series in the Chinese market. Industry partners, including Lenovo, xFusion, Minisforum, GMKtec, Emdoor, Colorful, Amaqi, and Liulian, showcased nine new products powered by the flagship Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 processor. These products span various form factors, including mini PCs and desktop AI workstations. AMD expects more than 20 related products to hit the market soon.

The flagship Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 is built on the Zen 5 architecture, featuring a 16-core, 32-thread CPU, a 40-CU Radeon 8065S GPU, and an NPU delivering up to 55 TOPS of AI performance.

The platform supports up to 192 GB of unified memory, with up to 160 GB allocatable as graphics memory (VRAM). AMD claims the processor can run models with up to 300 billion parameters locally while fully supporting both Windows 11 and Linux x86_64 ecosystems.

title_zh: iPhone 17 系列官网涨价后，线下渠道降价 500 至 800 元
content_zh:
据界面新闻 9 月 11 日报道，苹果官网在秋季发布会后上调 iPhone 17 系列售价，但北京线下渠道已开始降价。华贸购物中心苹果直营店的 iPhone 17e 参与国补后售价为 4799 元，比官网的 5299 元低 500 元；海淀一家苹果门店的 iPhone 17 优惠后为 6299 元，同样比官网低 500 元。

iPhone 17 Pro 系列已从苹果官网下架。上述海淀门店称，256GB 版 iPhone 17 Pro 自 9 月 9 日起优惠 800 元，售价从 8999 元降至 8199 元。京东 Apple 产品自营旗舰店的 256GB 版 iPhone 17 报价为 5469 元，比当前官网价格低 1330 元，也低于发布时的 5999 元。
title_en: iPhone 17 Prices Drop by 500 to 800 Yuan in Offline Channels Despite Official Online Price Hikes
content_en:
Following Apple's autumn launch event, the official website raised prices for the iPhone 17 series. However, offline retail channels in Beijing have already begun slashing prices by 500 to 800 RMB, according to a report by Jiemian News on September 11.

At the Apple Store in China Central Place, the iPhone 17e is priced at 4,799 RMB after applying China's national green subsidy—500 RMB cheaper than the official online price of 5,299 RMB. Similarly, an Apple retailer in Beijing's Haidian District is offering the standard iPhone 17 for 6,299 RMB, also a 500 RMB discount compared to the official website.

Meanwhile, the iPhone 17 Pro series has been delisted from Apple's official website. The Haidian retailer revealed that the 256GB iPhone 17 Pro has received an 800 RMB discount since September 9, bringing its price down from 8,999 RMB to 8,199 RMB. On JD.com's official Apple flagship store, the 256GB iPhone 17 is listed at 5,469 RMB, which is 1,330 RMB lower than the current official price and below its original launch price of 5,999 RMB.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜按几下方向键，捏出一只会动的 3D 数字生物
content_zh:
艺术家 Pat Bloom 做了浏览器互动装置 Cybernetic。页面每次会先生成一个随机 3D 物体，方向键和鼠标控制观察角度，按 Enter 换颜色，按空格则生成另一套构图。不同选择会把它逐渐变成一只不断摆动、伸展的数字生物。

完成后可以锁定作品，再生成链接或二维码分享；成品在电脑和手机浏览器中都能单独运行。Bloom 说，这个项目是在没有固定方案的情况下与 AI 边做边试完成的，页面里的颜色、形状和动画则由他编写。
title_en: One Fun Thing | Shape Your Own Animated 3D Digital Creature with a Few Keystrokes
content_en:
Artist Pat Bloom has launched *Cybernetic*, an interactive browser-based installation. Upon loading, the site generates a random 3D object. Users can adjust the viewing angle using their mouse and arrow keys, change colors by pressing Enter, and generate entirely new compositions with the Spacebar. Through these simple interactions, the object gradually morphs into a wriggling, stretching digital creature.

Once satisfied, users can lock their creation and generate a shareable link or QR code. The final piece runs seamlessly on both desktop and mobile browsers.

According to Bloom, the project was developed through an iterative, trial-and-error process with AI, rather than following a rigid blueprint. However, Bloom personally coded all the colors, shapes, and animations featured on the page.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《The Sun Never Sets》把三角恋拍成一场爱情实验
content_zh:
Joe Swanberg 时隔 6 年推出新剧情长片《The Sun Never Sets》。故事发生在阿拉斯加安克雷奇，Dakota Fanning 与 Jake Johnson 饰演一对夫妻，Cory Michael Smith 饰演进入两人生活的第三者。

影片延续 Swanberg 的创作方法：导演先给出人物关系和场景框架，再让演员在拍摄中即兴完成具体对话。三角关系因此没有被写成单纯的出轨悬念，而是逐步暴露三个人对亲密、自由和承诺的不同理解。

影片正在纽约 IFC Center 等院线放映。《纽约客》的权威影评把即兴表演视为影片的力量来源，认为演员在场景中不断改变关系重心，让这段爱情实验保留了难以预设的紧张感。
title_en: Weekend Watch | 'The Sun Never Sets' Turns a Love Triangle into a Captivating Romance Experiment
content_en:
Director Joe Swanberg returns after a six-year hiatus with his new feature film, *The Sun Never Sets*. Set in Anchorage, Alaska, the movie stars Dakota Fanning and Jake Johnson as a married couple whose lives are disrupted by a third party, played by Cory Michael Smith.

The film stays true to Swanberg’s signature filmmaking style. Rather than relying on a rigid script, the director provided the actors with character relationships and scene frameworks, allowing them to improvise the actual dialogue during filming. This approach elevates the love triangle beyond a simple story of infidelity, instead peeling back the layers on how the three individuals perceive intimacy, freedom, and commitment.

Currently screening at theaters like New York’s IFC Center, the film has garnered praise from *The New Yorker*. The review highlights the improvised performances as the source of the film's strength, noting how the actors constantly shift the emotional center of gravity to maintain an unpredictable, captivating tension.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《Simplify》用三步法清理工作中的无效复杂度
content_zh:
Axios 创始人 Mike Allen、Jim VandeHei 和 Roy Schwartz 在新书《Simplify》中，把处理复杂工作的办法概括为三个动作：Confront、Delete 和 Amplify。先直面最重要的问题，再删除不必要的任务，最后集中资源放大真正有效的部分。

作者们把这套方法用于会议、邮件、日程和组织决策，也建议让 AI Agent 帮忙检查任务是否值得保留。书末提供了一个配套 Agent 的二维码，但三人也强调，复杂问题不能靠统一指令全部压平。《Simplify》将于 9 月 15 日出版。
title_en: The Unread Book Guide | 'Simplify' Offers a Three-Step Framework to Eliminate Workplace Complexity
content_en:
In their upcoming book *Simplify*, Axios founders Mike Allen, Jim VandeHei, and Roy Schwartz outline a straightforward three-step methodology to tackle workplace complexity: Confront, Delete, and Amplify. The framework advises professionals to first confront the most critical issues, delete unnecessary tasks, and finally amplify what actually works by concentrating resources there.

The authors apply this system to meetings, emails, scheduling, and organizational decision-making. They also suggest leveraging AI agents to help evaluate whether certain tasks are worth keeping.

While the book includes a QR code linking to a companion AI agent, the authors caution that complex organizational problems cannot be solved by uniform prompts alone. *Simplify* is set to be published on September 15.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《Build that Bridge》让陌生玩家一起消方块搭桥
content_zh:
荷兰艺术家和社会设计师 Wouter Sieuwerts 制作了免费浏览器游戏《Build that Bridge》。玩法借用了落块消除：每清除完整一行，桥梁就会从河流两岸向中间延伸一段。

玩家可以新建一座桥，也可以加入其他人的桥。页面会显示参与人数、累计消除的行数，以及两岸成功相遇的次数。游戏不用安装，没有广告，也不收集个人数据；一局里的每次消除都会变成一项可以和陌生人共同完成的建设。
title_en: Collaborative Browser Game "Build that Bridge" Connects Strangers Through Block-Clearing
content_en:
Dutch artist and social designer Wouter Sieuwerts has launched *Build that Bridge*, a free browser-based game that reimagines classic block-clearing mechanics as a collaborative experience. In this game, every cleared line of blocks extends a bridge from opposite riverbanks toward the center.

Players can choose to start a new bridge or join an ongoing project initiated by others. The game's interface displays real-time statistics, including the number of active participants, total lines cleared, and how many times the two sides have successfully met.

Designed as a pure, shared experience, *Build that Bridge* requires no installation, contains no advertisements, and does not collect personal data. It successfully transforms a traditionally solitary puzzle game into a meaningful, collective construction project with strangers.
